ops.title: Retain codex-ask self-reexec images across package upgrades
ops.description:
Owner: /root/codex125_release_install.

Homebrew upgrade removed the old Caskroom executable while incumbent codex-ask processes still referenced it for detach-middle/worker reexec. The exact old path was restored from verified retained bytes. initSelf stores the resolved versioned executable path; detachWorker and detachMiddle execute it later.

Next: agree on an immutable consumer self-image cache versus a shared daemonkit primitive, then prepare an isolated source fix with CI-only regression and cost checks. Existing daemonkit.Stable is a mutable launchd deployment policy, not an immutable per-process image.

Evidence: old-canonical-self-image-restoration.json, activation-churn-review.json, and source-isolation-proof.json under /Users/yasyf/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/runs/20261026T235128-repeat/fundamental-efficiency/codex125-release/.

ops.text: CI reproduces removing the original install path before both deferred self-reexec hops and proves the original generation still starts.
Use immutable retained executable bytes outside versioned install directories; preserve logical invocation paths and never overwrite another generation.
Preserve existing daemon/session behavior; CI grades macOS/Linux regressions and launch cost without a full binary read or copy on every warm invocation.
Carry the independent source fix through review, CI, merge, release, local installation and affected-case verification before task completion.
